title: RFL TactileManifold — per-sensor-class adapter mapping
description: A per-sensor-class adapter (04-tactile-manifold.md § The adapter mapping): the declarative raw-signal -> manifold-feature mapping contract a sensor class encodes. An embodiment's contact-sensor descriptor binds to one by `sensor_class`. The adapter declares the contract — which raw channels produce which manifold features, at which sites, at what resolution — and never the numeric algorithm that computes a feature from raw data (that is the implementation's, below RFL; Principle 4). The closed-core feature vocabulary is asserted identical to skill-isa's (validate.py C5).

raw_signal.description: The sensor's native output — the input side of the mapping.

feature_production.description: The raw -> manifold-feature mapping contract; one entry per feature the class produces.

resolution_envelope.description: Optional: the per-feature resolution the class achieves; the descriptor's per-embodiment resolution instantiates it.

ClassToken.description: The sensor class this adapter serves. The four representative classes (ft / array / visuotactile / pneumatic) are illustrative, not normative (Principle 4), so this is a token — a core token or an ext.<ns>.<class> registered class (06) — never a closed enum.

Identifier.description: A raw-channel name, referenced by feature_production.sources.

Length.description: A length value: a unit-suffixed quantity string (m / mm / cm).

Frequency.description: A frequency value: a unit-suffixed quantity string (Hz).

TactileFeature.description: A TactileManifold feature (04 § Feature taxonomy): one of the eleven closed-core features, or an ext.<ns>.<name> registered extension feature (06). The closed core is fixed so the conformance suite can enumerate it; asserted identical to skill-isa's TactileFeature core (validate.py C5).

RawChannel.description: One native sensor output channel. `layout.kind` fixes the raw spatial arrangement; the per-kind detail (count / extent / spacing) is the adapter's and stays floored.

quantity.description: The physical quantity the channel carries (a token, e.g. force_vector / pressure / deformation_field / chamber_pressure).

FeatureProduction.description: One manifold feature and where it comes from: `sources` names the raw channels (the dependency, not the formula), `kind` records how the feature relates to them.

kind.description: direct (the channel is the feature), derived (computed from the channel(s)), aggregated (pooled across raw elements).

SiteModel.description: How the class's raw layout resolves into the abstract sites a TactileTarget's quantifiers bind to (04 § Site model).

site_kind.description: per_element (one site per raw element), clustered (from a dense grid), patch (image regions), aggregate (one site per chamber).

roles.description: The relational site roles this class can populate; a quantifier referencing a role the class cannot serve is unsatisfiable and degrades.

clustering.description: The deterministic rule a dense class uses to resolve a quantifier into sites; the rule is the adapter's, RFL requires only determinism (04 § Site model). Floored.

FeatureResolution.description: The resolution the class achieves for one feature; `value` (per-feature least-count) is feature-specific and floored.
